creation_rules.capture_files: O_CREAT|O_EXCL with stdout, stderr, wait status, signal receipts, timestamps, and tree snapshots outside the evidence root

fresh_campaign.isolation_rule: Use one evidence root per fault. Unsealed hard-loss roots must never be siblings of sealed runs because global-freshness scanning would make unrelated public reopens fail.

minimum_external_harness.process_model: One serial POSIX controller using fork/exec or subprocess pipes; stdin and stdout remain binary.
required_features: one existing empty PW_R9_EVIDENCE_ROOT per case

SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGKILL, and inherited signal-mask control

minimum_external_harness.sentinel_precondition: Before the first runner process, prove the sentinel is unequal to every canary expected_output_utf8 used by these harnesses.

summary.event_protocol_ambiguity: The build contract says actual-mode root events follow one fresh collaboration subagent invocation. A zero-external-invocation harness can mechanically generate canonical receipt and terminal lines, but the current public surface has no declared actual-mode transport-stub lane. Such runs must not be credited as experiment-valid until that interpretation is explicitly resolved.
summary.raw_boundary_limitation: A valid terminal line enables raw_result.json and completion.json without a public synchronization point between them. An untyped five-file raw prefix can be produced deterministically with an invalid terminal event, but a literal hard crash after a valid raw capture and before completion is not deterministically reachable through the current public surface.
summary.repeated_signal_limitation: The runner persists one Boolean stop state and no signal count or signal identity. The evidence tree cannot independently prove that two signals were delivered; only create-only controller receipts can record that fact.
